summary: Compass Diversified Holdings (CODI) disclosed the divestiture of Sterno's food service business via an 8-K filing. On March 28, 2026, CODI, as stockholder representative, entered into a definitive merger agreement with WCHG Buyer, Inc., acquiring all outstanding equity of Sterno. The filing notes Sterno owns both a food service and home fragrance business, but no exact deal terms, price per share, premium, or advisor are provided. The transaction closed or will close under a merger structure. Watch for regulatory clearance and CODI's focus on remaining home fragrance assets.
